skill.displayName: 企业所得税纳税调整核对（免费版）

version.changelog: 正文新增「免费网页版」入口；名称取自 SKILL.md

llm.summary: The skill runs a local tax-table checker, but its runtime output can overstate that some compliance checks were performed when they were actually withheld.

dimensions.detail: Reading a user-provided tax table file is proportionate to the stated function. The script comments and UI mention anonymous usage statistics and a --no-stats option, but the inspected code does not implement network statistics or that flag.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: No package installation, external dependency, remote payload retrieval, or network import mechanism was found. The runner uses Node standard-library file reads for user-specified inputs and loads the bundled engine.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The SKILL.md clearly says the free version runs six checks and excludes five paid checks; this partially mitigates the runtime mismatch. User-facing text is Chinese, which fits the PRC tax domain.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No persistence, credential access, environment-variable access, background service, file mutation, or privilege escalation behavior was found.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The core purpose is coherent: a deterministic local checker for Chinese corporate income tax adjustment tables. However, the engine returns limit-rate metadata and a disclaimer saying it checks reference limits even though those limit checks are listed as not run, which can create false assurance in a tax-compliance workflow.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Review carefully before installing for real tax work. The tool appears local and non-persistent, but do not treat a clean result as confirmation that entertainment, advertising, donation, tax-rate, or negative-taxable-income checks were performed; those checks are withheld despite some runtime wording suggesting otherwise.
llm.findings:
[TP4] unexpected: Accepted in part: the package purpose matches its local tax-checking behavior, but the runtime disclaimer and returned limit-rate fields blur the boundary between executed free checks and withheld paid checks.
[AE1] expected: Overridden: scripts/run.mjs was present in the workspace and was fully inspected; no analysis-evasion behavior was found.
[SDI-4] unexpected: Accepted: the disclaimer says the tool checks reference limits for entertainment, advertising, and donation items, while the implementation lists those checks under checks_not_run and does not execute them.
[SQP-3] expected: Downgraded: Chinese-only user-facing text is consistent with a China-specific corporate income tax workflow and is not a security concern by itself.
[SDI-1] unexpected: Accepted in part: exposing rate_refs and limit_rates in active result scope alongside a misleading disclaimer may cause downstream users or agents to treat unexecuted paid-only checks as covered.
